name: poselib
description: Minimal solvers for calibrated camera pose estimation. Pinned to cdcseacave/PoseLib commit 2845f80b908360b4ebb9dddba94be80e5499d374 from feature/generalized-absolute-pose-scale (upstream master through #215 merged in), which adds estimate_generalized_absolute_pose_scale and its bearing variant estimate_generalized_absolute_pose_scale_bearings, solving a rig pose together with the scale of the rig relative to the 3D points, on top of the unified bearing-vector estimate_* API for pinhole and spherical (equirectangular) cameras; opt.max_error is angular (radians) for the bearing estimators.
